reason: Phase78's finite Adam probe ends with noisy minibatch loss above log2 and has no full-risk stationarity check. Its weak assessment AUC cannot distinguish weak accessible signal from probe optimization underfit.
hypothesis: Optimize exactly the same event-uniform,class-balanced convex logistic pair risk to distinguish the prior probe optimizer limitation from limitations of this fixed feature family.

native,Adam,L-BFGS-B and shuffled-null same-B/cross-B pair AUC,event and pooled supports
decision: Any optimizer benefit is probe-only, not exact membership or physics. If convergence succeeds and accessible signal substantially exceeds native assignment with null/background controls, formulate one deployable controlled intervention and admit it separately. If signal remains weak, do not invent a loss/threshold/data/width sweep. If not converged, report numerical limits rather than information absence.
invariants: No scientific encoder/decoder update, corpus/width/geometry/normalization/acceptance unchanged, truth only supervised probe fitting and after-trace evaluation. No new cohorts, sealed test,primary reservation or page publication.
